user_gesture: confirmed macOS accessibility three-finger mouse drag

evidence_levels.finding: Point mode empty-space drag enters region selection; each dragged Move and Up runs synchronous exact region query.
Region selection rebuilds full compact contour and subtracts every historical mask from every component before local region intersection; it does not consume the shared prepared exact path.

This expensive selection path is a strong candidate for the recorded sustained freeze, but no exact user event/stack capture proves it was the sole cause. Missing terminal input or stuck active session remains possible.
Default-budget DPR2/4 dense native fixture requires 13/12/12 stable calls per three changed poses and static reuse0; continuous Move under nondefault maxEntries1 remains0/60accepted.
Input and frame WASM calls share the JS event thread. GPU fence pending also gates further frame preparation; CPU blocking, GPU/resource waiting, and repeated work invalidation are different causes.

synthetic_probe.scope: one native optimized build, synthetic full-history code path, no browser performance or user document identity claim

proposed_order_not_dispatched: First UR2d slice: localized exact selection/erase query reuse, eliminating repeated body/history preparation; keep selection tolerance, fill rules, real mask semantics and independent oracle. Add precise mouse Down/Move/Up/Cancel continuity diagnosis for blank-space point drag.

Continue UR2d Up critical path: query, publication preparation, Operation apply, History and Scene timing; optimize repeated work, retaining existing synchronous commit semantics unless separately designed.

UR3: continuous operation transitions and default pressure paths; compatible staged progress/static ordered ranges, masked transforms, navigation and preview routes. Validate immediate actions without waiting for settle.
Then targeted worker execution for measured remaining irreducible CPU tasks. Move this earlier only if a valid bounded decomposition cannot keep the owner responsive.
